form:FormGroup.label: Entity ID
form:FormGroup.helpText: The column identifying each entity - a person, vehicle or asset. Events are grouped by it, so each distinct value becomes one thing drawn on the map. It must name a column this query selects, by the alias the query gives it; the default query aliases it 'Entity ID'. If it names nothing the query selects, no entity reaches the map at all, even though the query still returns rows - so the map looks as though playback is switched off.

form:FormGroup.label: Location
form:FormGroup.helpText: The column holding literal coordinates, in the form 'x, y'. These are fixed at ingest: an entity placed this way stays where the event said and will NOT follow the object if it is moved in the Editor. Leave unset if your events name objects rather than positions. If both this and Location Ref are set on the same event, this one is used - it needs no lookup - and the contradiction is reported once in the console.

form:FormGroup.label: Location Ref
form:FormGroup.helpText: The column holding the key of the object the event happened at - a desk, a gate, a camera. The entity is drawn wherever that object currently is, so moving the object in the Editor moves everyone recorded as being at it, retroactively. This is usually the one you want. Leave unset if your events carry coordinates instead.

form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The column holding what kind of thing each entity is - person, vehicle, asset. Type is the layer key: it selects the entity's style and its row in the Layers panel. Optional. Left unset, or absent from the data, an entity whose ID looks like an email address is treated as a person and everything else as an object - which means a vehicle cannot be styled as one until this is mapped.
